Alban Lafont.note: Lafont sits behind the starter for Côte d'Ivoire, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Alban Lafont.noteZh: 他给Côte d'Ivoire保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Amad Diallo.note: Diallo has been one of Côte d'Ivoire's real scoring stories, with goals against Ecuador and Norway. His danger is arriving before defenders have finished sorting the first problem.
Amad Diallo.noteZh: 他让Côte d'Ivoire拥有一个必须被惦记的得分点。每个松散球都可能突然变重。

Ange-Yoan Bonny.summary: Ange-Yoan Bonny is a Côte d'Ivoire centre-forward at Inter Milan who gives the national team hold-up play, box presence, and power running.
Ange-Yoan Bonny.note: Bonny has been part of how Côte d'Ivoire turns territory into chances. Watch the run before the pass, not only the shot after it.
Ange-Yoan Bonny.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Bazoumana Toure.note: Touré is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Côte d'Ivoire, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Bazoumana Toure.noteZh: 他给Côte d'Ivoire提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Christ Inao Oulai.note: Oulaï gives Côte d'Ivoire midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Christ Inao Oulai.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Côte d'Ivoire来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Christopher Operi.note: Opéri is back-line insurance for Côte d'Ivoire. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Christopher Operi.noteZh: 他给Côte d'Ivoire那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Elye Wahi.note: Wahi is attacking depth for Côte d'Ivoire. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Elye Wahi.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Emmanuel Agbadou.note: Agbadou is in the quiet-work part of Côte d'Ivoire's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Emmanuel Agbadou.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Evan Ndicka.note: Ndicka is the kind of defender Côte d'Ivoire can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Evan Ndicka.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Evann Guessand.note: Guessand gives Côte d'Ivoire midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Evann Guessand.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Côte d'Ivoire来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Franck Kessie.note: Kessié is on the scoresheet for Côte d'Ivoire, with his goal coming against Germany. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Franck Kessie.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Ghislain Konan.note: Konan gives Côte d'Ivoire one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Ghislain Konan.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Guela Doue.note: Doué is in the quiet-work part of Côte d'Ivoire's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Guela Doue.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Ibrahim Sangare.note: Sangaré has supplied one of Côte d'Ivoire's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Ibrahim Sangare.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Côte d'Ivoire创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Jean Michael Seri.note: Seri gives Côte d'Ivoire a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Jean Michael Seri.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Mohamed Kone.note: Koné is goalkeeper cover for Côte d'Ivoire. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Mohamed Kone.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Nicolas Pepe.note: Pépé has given Côte d'Ivoire both the finish and the pass, including goals against Curaçao. That double threat is why defenders cannot settle on one answer.
Nicolas Pepe.noteZh: 他已经把进球和助攻都放进了Côte d'Ivoire的赛事故事里。看点是第一脚之后，第二个动作有多快。

Odilon Kossounou.note: Kossounou has been part of Côte d'Ivoire's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Odilon Kossounou.noteZh: 他给Côte d'Ivoire后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Oumar Diakite.note: Diakité gives Côte d'Ivoire a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Oumar Diakite.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Ousmane Diomande.note: Diomande is defensive cover for Côte d'Ivoire's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Ousmane Diomande.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Parfait Guiagon.summary: Parfait Guiagon is a Côte d'Ivoire left winger at Charleroi who gives the national team tight-space dribbling, left-side creativity, and quick combinations.
Parfait Guiagon.note: Guiagon gives Côte d'Ivoire a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Parfait Guiagon.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Seko Fofana.note: Fofana is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Côte d'Ivoire, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Seko Fofana.noteZh: 他给Côte d'Ivoire提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Simon Adingra.note: Adingra gives Côte d'Ivoire a route when possession needs to become pressure. He is there to make a defender choose.
Simon Adingra.noteZh: 他是Côte d'Ivoire这届赛事中被重点使用的进攻路线之一。他先让第一名防守者移动，再让终结或最后一传出现。

Wilfried Singo.note: Singo has already made a goal happen for Côte d'Ivoire. His value is picking the moment when the defense is still moving.
Wilfried Singo.noteZh: 他已经为Côte d'Ivoire送出一次进球前的传球。重点是机会真正显眼前的那次触球。

Yahia Fofana.note: Fofana has been Côte d'Ivoire's goalkeeper through this run. His value is keeping the box calm long enough for the next attack to start cleanly.
Yahia Fofana.noteZh: 他给Côte d'Ivoire提供从后场开始的冷静第一步。看他如何把扑救或摘球变成重新组织。

Yan Diomande.note: Diomande has one tournament assist in the bank for Côte d'Ivoire. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Yan Diomande.noteZh: 他已经帮Côte d'Ivoire制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。
